title: The Teardown 004 — One prompt, two racks, no winner
description: Jensen Huang said AGI has arrived, so one prompt went to GPT-6 Pro and to Fable 5.1 with a clock on both. This is the rig behind the film: what was held equal, what could not be, why the two elapsed times are not a race, and the 45-line harness that scored both files the same way. Plus the ARC-AGI-3 footnote that turns 62.7 into 99.9, and a first-party measurement that the model you ask for is not always the model that answers.
og_title: One prompt, two racks, no winner — The Teardown 004
og_description: The test rig behind the Astra vs Fable film: the frozen prompt, the identical evaluation sequence, the two clocks that cannot be compared, and the harness file. Why the film declared no winner, on purpose.
og_alt: Two lanes, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and ChatGPT with GPT-6 Pro, each listing its own system prompt, tools, search, reasoning setting and clock. A boundary line reads: the file comes back, from here on identical. Below it one shared box: frozen prompt, headless Chrome 145, fifteen scripted actions, screenshots read by a sub-agent, hardware claims checked against NVIDIA documentation.
